payload.name: Habit formation curve
payload.fact: With repetition of a behavior in a consistent context, automaticity increases following an asymptotic curve.
payload.boundary: The time to reach 95% of the asymptote of automaticity varies significantly between individuals.

provenance.title: How are habits formed: Modelling habit formation in the real world
